evidence: The official PRISM Climate Group site remains public and provides current gridded climate datasets, web services, formats, documentation and terms of use.
The North Temperate Lakes LTER data portal remains public and documents more than 300 archived EDI data packages plus core, high-frequency, survey, GIS and other datasets.

The DOI remains a persistently cited public Zenodo dataset identity for Stephan Rasp's 2019 Sample spcam dataset; later climate-model papers independently identify the record as the archived example SPCAM data used with the Rasp et al. workflow.
